seal.statement: A participant release caller whose original bounded deadline expires while awaiting a delivered reply cannot treat that reply's CUT_OVER, OBSERVED or other positive outcome as current permission. The one canonical participant-release-client response boundary must fail closed based on the same original TimeSource, without cancelling durable effects or inventing a new transport driver.
